title: Remote MCP write-scope refresh and portable Staging manifest convergence

phases.objective: Keep the Remote MCP write-scope inventory and its portable Staging manifest checksum convergent under the existing exact-head governed writer without widening mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The bounded writer treats the inventory JSON, Markdown, and portable Staging manifest as one deterministic output set and verifies the manifest checksum contract before any governed commit.
steps: Generate the Remote MCP write-scope inventory.
Update exactly one portable Staging manifest entry for the generated inventory JSON.
Repeat generation and manifest update to prove deterministic SHA-256 convergence.
Verify inventory currentness, inventory contract, and Staging manifest checksum closure.
Enforce the registered three-file generated write set and preserve exact-head and protected-branch guards.
assertions: The Remote MCP refresh recipe is explicit and bounded to exactly three generated outputs.
The portable Staging manifest contains exactly one entry for the generated Remote MCP write-scope inventory.
The manifest checksum is recomputed from the generated inventory and is stable across two passes.
The existing exact-head CAS and main/Production mutation prohibitions remain unchanged.
No force-push, database mutation, provider mutation, deployment, or secret capture is introduced.

phases.objective: Retain canonical evidence for exact-head generated-artifact refreshes and detect future writer/output drift without manual hash repair.
This contract does not authorize Production promotion or external mutation.
